description: Use this when the user wants a finished Deepnia creation posted on their social accounts, now or at a time they choose: Deepnia posts it with their caption (no credits). Confirm the accounts, caption and time with the user first; for TikTok, ask them to accept TikTok's music and content rules (tiktok_consent).

caption.description: The post text with its hashtags, in the user's language.

media_url.description: The result link of a completed creation (get_creation or list_my_creations).

scheduled_for.description: ISO 8601 time with its offset, at least 2 minutes ahead, to schedule. Absent: posted now.

tiktok_consent.description: true once the user accepted TikTok's music and content rules.

timezone.description: The user's IANA time zone, for example Africa/Abidjan.

name: publish_creation
title: Post or schedule on social networks
